descriptions.text: Tether, the issuer of USDT, issued a statement stating that its system was hacked by an external attacker on the 19th of this month and stolen USDT tokens worth approximately $31 million from its Tether Treasury wallet.

On November 19, 2017, Tether's treasury wallet on the Bitcoin blockchain was compromised, resulting in the unauthorized transfer of approximately $30.95 million USDT to an external address. Tether issued a protocol-level freeze to prevent these tokens from entering circulation. The root cause was a breach of Tether's treasury wallet, which was apparently protected by a single private key. The attacker gained access to this key and executed an unauthorized USDT transfer via Omni Layer, exposing the risk of single-key wallet custody.
